summary: Submitted a research handoff recording two confirmed implementation obligations and four unexecuted sourced questions. CheckRun 3c9d7e6ae7a04f4f9ce7a782e755960a confirmed that VerifyLeader can return confirmed with only the leader's own voter contact against quorum 2 when a configured non-voter answers the verification heartbeat. CheckRun 84aeffcaf772412e93f040b18483d2b5 confirmed that when one FSM value implements BatchingFSM and ConfigurationStore, a committed LogConfiguration entry reaches ApplyBatch while StoreConfiguration is never invoked. Both executions exited 0, produced complete violating witnesses, and their review conditions are resolved. Remaining leads are explicitly unconfirmed: stale or delayed TimeoutNow disruption, installSnapshot post-snapshot log state, appendEntries StoreLogs failure after suffix deletion, and AddNonvoter treatment of an existing Voter. Preflight is valid; no third execution was requested before the closing window.
